Annotate isotopes within feature groups

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/methods-numeric.R, R/methods-XcmsExperiment.R
annotateIsotopes.Rd

annotateIsotopes() labels isotope patterns within each feature group in CAMERA syntax: "[3][M]+" is the monoisotopic peak of pattern 3, "[3][M+1]+" its first isotopologue, and so on. Features that are not part of a pattern get "".

Usage

annotateIsotopes(object, param, ...)

# S4 method for class 'numeric,IsotopologueParam'
annotateIsotopes(object, param, intensity, groups, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XcmsExperiment,IsotopologueParam'
annotateIsotopes(object, param, ...)

Arguments

object

For the numeric method: the m/z values of the features. For the XcmsExperiment method: an xcms::XcmsExperiment with feature groups (see MsFeatures::groupFeatures()).

param

An IsotopologueParam object.

...

ignored.

intensity

numeric, for the numeric method only: one representative intensity per feature, e.g. the median over the study samples.

groups

for the numeric method only: one group label per feature.

Value

For the numeric method a character vector with one label per feature. For the XcmsExperiment method the object, with the labels in the isotopes column of featureDefinitions() and the parameters in metadata(object)$IonFamilies$isotopes.

See also

IsotopologueParam(), isIsotopologue(), annotateAdducts()

Examples

## Ions of 2-furoylglycine (M = 169.0375) in one feature group
mz <- c(95.0124, 124.0392, 152.0342, 170.0445, 171.0496, 192.0275,
        377.0300, 393.0019)
int <- c(71.6, 81.4, 49.8, 100, 4.33, 11.3, 1.76, 1.82)
annotateIsotopes(mz, IsotopologueParam(), intensity = int,
                 groups = rep("FG.1", 8))
#> [1] ""          ""          ""          "[1][M]+"   "[1][M+1]+" ""         
#> [7] ""          ""
